compress/distill.description: Distil a large teacher into a small student adapter and hold promotion at a human gate. The quality DELTA is measured by a separate run — see `compress/distill-compare` — because measuring needs both models SERVED, which is a different spend with different failure modes than training.

base_model.description: The student being trained. Smaller than the teacher, or the run has no point.

jsd_beta.description: Generalized JSD interpolation: 0 ≈ forward KL, 1 ≈ reverse KL.

lmbda.description: On-policy student fraction. >0 makes the student GENERATE during training — a heavier GPU profile than plain SFT.

max_new_tokens.description: Tokens generated per completion — the cost driver when lmbda > 0.

registered_model_name.description: MLflow Registered Model for the student (empty = none).

seq_kd.description: Sequence-level KD (supervised FT on teacher-generated output).

stub.description: Deterministic tier: no torch, no trl, no GPU.

teacher_model.description: The larger model whose behaviour is copied.

compress/distill-compare.description: Measure a distilled student against its teacher on one closed-book harness, prove both measurements were valid, then gate promotion on eval/delta.

api_key_env.description: NAME of the env var holding the endpoint's bearer token — never the value.

delta_thresholds.description: eval/delta's regression budget. Looser than retrain-cycle's 2% on purpose: a distilled student is expected to give up some accuracy for a large cost saving, and the decision is how much — which is why the budget is an input and the final call is a human's.

eval_set.description: The split-labelled QA corpus BOTH models answer (path, s3:// URI, or a governed dataset:<name>@<v> ref).

judge_model.description: Gateway model grading answers. Judge-scored gains are untrusted_metric (ADR-0095 §2.6).

max_error_rate.description: Highest per-split error_rate either measurement may carry and still count as valid. 0.0 = every row must be measured.

max_per_split.description: Cost guard on both eval legs (0 = every question).

student_endpoint_url.description: Endpoint serving the STUDENT. UNSET (the default) = the same server, selected by model id. `default: null` NOT "" — $default falls back on missing-or-null only, and an empty string is a real value it would return as-is (#1728).

student_model.description: Model id the endpoint serves the distilled student under.

teacher_model.description: Model id the endpoint serves the teacher under.

plan_steps.gate: steps.teacher.findings.eval_closedbook_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.teacher.findings.eval_closedbook_paraphrase_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.teacher.findings.eval_closedbook_control_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.student.findings.eval_closedbook_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.student.findings.eval_closedbook_paraphrase_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.student.findings.eval_closedbook_control_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate

compress/quantize.description: Quantize a model, then gate on the measured quality delta.

artifact_target.description: Where to save the compressed artifact (hf | local | s3).

eval_tasks.description: lm-eval benchmarks to re-score the candidate on (empty → skip eval).

method.description: Quantization backend (bnb | gptq | awq | torchao | hqq | gguf).

model.description: Model or adapter to compress (HF id or local path).

output_name.description: Registry name for the compressed model (also the baseline lookup key).

run_eval.description: Whether to re-eval the compressed candidate.

compute/price-a-run.description: What a run would cost — live GPU offers beside cairn's own estimate.

gpu.description: Filter to GPU names containing this (case-insensitive). Blank = any.

max_results.description: Cap the returned offers, cheapest first.

min_vram_gb.description:
Only offers with at least this much VRAM per GPU. `compute/estimate`
reports the VRAM a run needs — pass that number here and the results are
offers that actually fit.

auth_type.description: bearer | header | query | basic | none — how the resolved credential is presented.

base_url.description: API base (https://api.example.com). Falls back to the connection's configured base_url.

connection.description: Connection NAME from Connectors (api_key/http/oauth). Its credential resolves at run time — the name is all this record carries.

cursor_field.description: Record field used for `watermark_out` and for dropping rows at or below `since`.

data_selector.description: Dotted path to the record array (data.items). Empty = the response IS the array.

eval_path.description: Optional eval set for decontamination (empty = honest skip).

next_url_path.description: json_link paginator: dotted path to the next URL in the response body.

paginator.description: single_page | page_number | offset | cursor | json_link | header_link.

register.description: Dataset-registry name to version the cleaned export under.

since.description: Only rows past this watermark. Feed the previous run's `watermark_out`; empty = a full first pull.

token_env.description: Alternative to `connection`: the NAME of an env var on the engine host holding a token.

dataset-readiness/check.description: Governed readiness gate for a fine-tuning dataset: seven deterministic checks (format, duplicates, contamination, PII, provenance, balance, trainer compatibility) into one cited verdict.

eval_model.description: Logical model name the eval judge uses (default gpt-4o-mini).

eval_path.description: Optional eval/benchmark JSONL to check contamination against.

eval_sample_size.description: How many (input, output) pairs to sample for the eval soft signal (default 20).

metadata_path.description: Optional dataset metadata JSON (license/source/synthetic) for provenance.

notion_page_id.description: Optional Notion page id. When set (and a Notion MCP server is configured), the cited report is appended to that page as a governance record. Omitted or unconfigured → publishing is a graceful no-op.

path.description: The dataset to check — either a local JSONL/JSON/CSV/parquet file path, or a Hugging Face Hub dataset id (e.g. "org/name"). Public Hub datasets load out of the box; private repos need a token (not yet wired — needs a SecretStore). All checks read through the same loader.

run_eval.description: Opt in to the LLM-as-judge soft signal (eval/judge). Off by default — it's non-deterministic, never gates, and costs LLM calls. Requires a reachable model.

sample_size.description: Optional. Run the STATISTICAL checks (format / PII density / profile) on a deterministic reservoir sample of this many rows instead of the whole dataset — a statistically valid estimate for a go/no-go gate that makes dataset SIZE irrelevant (#656). Exact checks (dedup, decontam) always scan in full. Omit to scan every row. The report marks a sampled verdict.

target_trainers.description: Trainers to report format compatibility for (default trl/unsloth/axolotl).

dataset-readiness/clean.description: Clean a dataset in one governed pass — normalize, drop duplicate rows, redact PII, export the result — with a report of exactly what changed.

batch_id.description: This batch's id within the dataset lineage (recorded on each published fingerprint; default 'batch').

compute_target.description: Unused since the fix trio was deleted (#2434): `clean` reaches a remote box through the deployment's dataflow engine binding instead.

dataset_id.description: Dataset lineage id. When set, `clean` publishes the cleaned rows' fingerprints to the cross-batch index so later batches dedup against this one (ADR-0080 P2).

eval_path.description: Eval/benchmark JSONL to decontaminate against. Omit to skip contamination removal.

format.description: Output format for the cleaned dataset — 'jsonl' (default) or 'parquet' (columnar, ADR-0080 D4).

normalize.description: Whitespace-collapse before hashing (default true; keep consistent with the check).

output_path.description: Where to write the final fixed JSONL (default /tmp/cairn-fix/fixed.jsonl).

parent_run.description: Lineage (#989): the run this fix descends from (the failed check). Carried into the job env as CAIRN_PARENT_RUN so the job + its fingerprints tie back. Usually set by `--from`, not by hand.

path.description: Source JSONL dataset to repair (the one a readiness check failed).

publish_fingerprints.description: Unused since the fix trio was deleted (#2434); `clean` always publishes when dataset_id is set. Kept so existing callers are not refused.

dataset-readiness/decontaminate.description: Measure n-gram and embedding overlap of a training set against a benchmark: how many rows are contaminated, which ones, and by how much.

bench.description:
The eval / benchmark JSONL to check against. Required here — without it the
operator reports `checked: false`, and a check that silently checked
nothing is worse than no check.

method.description:
`ngram` catches near-verbatim overlap; `minhash` catches paraphrase at
scale; `both` runs each and reports them separately, which is the default
because they disagree in informative ways.

ngram.description: Shingle window in words. Smaller windows flag more, and flag more falsely.

overlap_threshold.description: Similarity at or above which a row counts as contaminated (minhash).

eval_path.description: Optional eval set for decontamination (empty = honest skip).

path.description: Staged upload path or s3:// uri of the file to import.

register.description: Dataset-registry name to version the cleaned export under.

metadata_path.description: Optional dataset metadata JSON (license/source) for the provenance check.

split_group_by.description: Field to group by so a group never straddles splits (no within-group leakage).

Empty (default) writes files only.

test_ratio.description: Held-out test fraction (default 0.1 — feeds the model-eval gate,

register.description: Dataset-registry name to version the cleaned export under.

What the on-call (or the engine) actually did. Drives the
"What went well / What went wrong" sections. Optional in demo.

(deploy → error → alert), reconstructed from timestamped evidence

Source investigation id, recorded in the document header for

Human-language problem statement. e.g. "checkout latency spike,

Optional extra hint from whoever filed the incident. Not all

tracking_project.description: MLflow experiment / W&B project (empty = from output_name).

validate_pipeline.description: Run the whole training path on CPU with a tiny model first — zero GPU spend.

training/e2e-fullstack.description: Full-stack governed E2E — 10k-row dataset validation and fix (DuckDB dedup, PII redaction, decontamination), a data gate over the cleaned stats, real QLoRA training with MLflow tracking, a human promotion gate, and a cited agentic report through the LLM gateway.

accept_license.description: Required true when base_model is a gated catalog entry (#2027, ADR-0102 D5); ignored otherwise.

artifact_target.description: Where the adapter is persisted: hf | local | s3.

curate.description: Run the data-curate leg (sample → LLM judge → shortlist) and train on its export instead of prep's.

curate_keep.description: Top share of scored rows kept as the training shortlist.

curate_max_calls.description: Cost guard: max rows the judge scores (paid calls).

curate_min_score.description: data-quality gate: fail when the judge's mean score is below this (0 = no floor).

curate_sample.description: Rows reservoir-sampled from the cleaned corpus for scoring.

dataset.description: Raw corpus to prepare and train on.

epochs.description: Passes over the training set (ignored while max_steps > 0).

eval_probe.description: Held-out eval set for the contamination check (path; empty skips it loudly).

eval_split.description: Fraction held out for mid-training eval.

gpu.description: GPU type the backend provisions (T4, A10G, A100, …).

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id for artifact_target=hf; empty = derived from output_name.

init_adapter_uri.description: Adapter to CONTINUE training from. Empty = a fresh adapter.

judge_model.description: Gateway model id for the curation judge.

max_eval_loss.description: eval.checkpoints ceiling; 0 = no ceiling. Set low to prove the eval gate refuses.

max_steps.description: Cap on real training steps (CPU-box bounded).

output_name.description: Name of the produced LoRA adapter.

packing.description: Pack short rows into fixed-length sequences (predictable VRAM).

pii_backend.description: PII backend for the prep leg: auto (Presidio cascade, slow on real prose) | regex | duckdb (the regex tier as one vectorized SQL pass — secrets/emails/IPs/SSNs/cards/phones, no names).

pii_preset.description: PII cascade preset for the prep leg (backend auto): governed (regex + NER) | logs (Presidio pattern recognizers, NER off).

registered_model_name.description: MLflow Registered Model to add this adapter to (empty = none).

report_to.description: Experiment trackers: mlflow and/or wandb (empty = none).

save_steps.description: Checkpoint every N steps; a restart resumes from the last one.

save_total_limit.description: Keep only the N most-recent checkpoints (0 = unbounded).

stub.description: Test knob: stub the train kernel (smoke runs only — acceptance runs train for real).

target_modules.description: Comma-separated LoRA targets. Empty = the trainer's default.

validate_pipeline.description: Run the whole training path on CPU with a tiny model first — zero GPU spend.

training/facts-window.description: Synthesize one post-cutoff fact window into closed-book QA and prep its train slice, registering both as governed dataset versions. The retrain-cycle loop's input producer — CPU + judge only, no GPU.

cutoff.description: Window START — facts are sampled AFTER this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Move it forward each cycle so windows stay DISJOINT.

days.description: Event days sampled across the window (~3 cited facts/day).

eval_fraction.description: Share of FACTS held out for eval — held out by FACT, so no phrasing leaks between splits.

judge_model.description: Gateway model that turns facts into closed-book QA.

max_facts.description: Cost guard on QA generation (0 = every collected fact).

pii_backend.description: PII redaction tier for the train slice.

qa_register.description: Dataset-registry name for the FULL QA artifact (every split). Empty = export only.

seed.description: Sampling seed — same window + seed reproduces the same facts.

train_register.description: Dataset-registry name for the prepped TRAIN slice. Empty = export only.

training/finetune.description: Governed fine-tuning: compose the dataset-readiness gate, price the run before a GPU is provisioned, train a QLoRA adapter, gate it on held-out metrics, then promote it through a durable human approval — narrated into a cited report.

anon_backend.description: PII-scrub backend for the prep stage (default auto → presidio if the [pii] extra is present, else the zero-dep regex fallback).

artifact_target.description: Where to save the trained adapter (default hf).

base_model.description: HF model id of the base to fine-tune (default Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct).

baseline_benchmark_metrics.description: Prior promoted model's public-benchmark scores ({suite/metric: value}) to regression-gate this run against (#895, eval/delta). Empty ⇒ no baseline gate (first run / not supplied). Typically the incumbent model/register.eval_scores.

benchmark_backend.description: Inference engine for the benchmark (#543): hf (portable) | vllm (fast GPU — big suites like MMLU) | llama-cpp (GGUF/CPU). Default hf.

benchmark_dry_run.description: Force the deterministic benchmark stub without touching the harness (default false).

benchmark_limit.description: Cap examples per suite to bound cost/time (default 200; a GSM8K subset).

benchmark_suites.description: Benchmark suites to run (default ["ifeval","gsm8k"] — LOCKED, cost-bounded). Pass e.g. ["mmlu","gsm8k","arc_challenge","hellaswag"] to check general reasoning.

checkpoint_bucket.description: S3 bucket to mirror training checkpoints to for durable resume (remote path). Empty → local-only.

checkpoint_prefix.description: S3 key prefix for mirrored checkpoints (default "cairn-checkpoints").

compute_target.description: Name of a compute.ssh connection (cairn connect add ssh) for the SSH-dispatch remote-training path. Honored only by bindings that route training through run-train-remote (remote/exec) — e.g. training/train-remote-smoke, or a governed bundle once #581 selects the train operator per target. The default train/finetune templates bind train/stub and do NOT dispatch to compute_target (#586); set it there and training still runs the local stub.

curate_enabled.description: Run the LLM-judge quality-curation front-stage and train on only the kept examples (default false; paid LLM).

curate_keep_fraction.description: Keep the top fraction of rows by score (0.0-1.0), overriding curate_threshold. e.g. 0.2 keeps the best 20%.

curate_max_samples.description: Cost guard — cap the number of examples scored by the paid judge (default 200).

curate_method.description: Curation method: 'alpagasus' (single 0-5 quality score, default) | 'deita' (complexity × quality).

curate_threshold.description: Keep rows scoring >= this (AlpaGasus default 4.5 when neither threshold nor keep_fraction is set). Mutually exclusive with curate_keep_fraction.

dataset_path.description: Dataset of (input,output) pairs — a local JSONL path for local training, OR (when compute_target is set for remote training) an S3/HF/https URI or HF Hub id that resolves on the worker. A local path with a compute_target is rejected at submit (#571).

dataset_rows.description: Approx number of training rows — feeds the pre-flight cost estimate (default 1000).

eval_delta_thresholds.description: Regression budget for the baseline gate (eval/delta): max_regression_pct (default 2%), warn_regression_pct, directions, require_metrics. Empty ⇒ defaults.

eval_split.description: Fraction held out for mid-training eval (default 0.1).

gpu.description: GPU type for the run — feeds the cost/feasibility estimate (default A100).

gpu_memory_utilization.description: vLLM GPU memory fraction for the served endpoint (default 0.9).

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id (user/name) when artifact_target=hf.

max_model_len.description: Max context length for the served endpoint (default None → model default).

max_steps.description: Cap training steps; >0 overrides epochs (default 0 = use epochs).

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI (e.g. http://mlflow.host:5000). Passed to the box as MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI so the trainer's MLflowCallback logs there. Empty → the box's own MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI env (if any); absent both ⇒ no MLflow logging.

mock_adapter_uri.description: e2e only — when set, train/stub returns this REAL adapter URI instead of training (mock-train → real artifact).

mock_metrics.description: e2e only — real metrics returned alongside mock_adapter_uri (e.g. {train_loss, eval_loss}).

model_gate_thresholds.description: Overrides for the model-eval gate (model/gate). Keys mirror ModelGateThresholds, notably min_benchmark_scores — a {suite/metric: min} map, e.g. {"ifeval/prompt_level_strict_acc": 0.4}. Absent keys keep the operator defaults.

notion_page_id.description: Notion page id to append the run summary to (run-publish-notion). Empty → publish skipped gracefully.

output_name.description: Name for the produced adapter + registry model (default "adapter").

prep_enabled.description: Run the PII-scrub + train/val/test split front-stage and train on the scrubbed train split (default false).

price_per_hr.description: Actual GPU rental price $/hr for the cost estimate/gate. Unset → the built-in per-GPU heuristic.

report_to.description: Experiment trackers to report to, e.g. ["mlflow"] (default [] = none).

run_benchmark.description: Run the public-benchmark step (eval/benchmark) on the trained adapter (default false).

save_steps.description: Write a training checkpoint every N steps (feeds save_steps + the S3 mirror). Smaller ⇒ more frequent durable checkpoints; default lets the trainer pick (~every steps/2).

serve_enabled.description: After a successful promote, serve the model behind a vLLM endpoint and benchmark it (default false). Requires a GPU compute_target.

serve_port.description: Port for the served vLLM endpoint (default 8000).

served_model_name.description: OpenAI-API model name for the served endpoint (default "cairn-model").

slack_channel.description: Slack channel override for the run summary (run-notify-slack). Empty → the webhook's default channel.

stage.description: Registry stage to promote into (default staging).

test_ratio.description: Prep split held-out test fraction (default 0.1) — the split the significance gate scores on.

topic.description: Free-text topic for the RAG/memory steps in the e2e-fullstack template (recall-context / remember-run).

tracking_project.description: Tracking experiment/project name (MLflow experiment / W&B project). Default the output_name.

tracking_run_name.description: Tracking run name (default the cairn run_id).

train_command.description: Override the on-box training command for train/remote (default "cairn-train-local").

validate_pipeline.description: Validate the WHOLE pipeline on CPU before GPU (#536): a tiny random model + throttle runs the real dataset/gates/tracking/eval path in ~10-20 min with zero GPU. Also settable per-box via CAIRN_TRAIN_VALIDATE=1 (default false).

validate_seconds.description: Stretch the validate-mode tiny job to a real wall-time (CAIRN_TRAIN_VALIDATE_SECONDS) so cancel/resume/poll have time to act (default 0).

training/proxy-rank.description: Rank a portfolio of training configurations with cheap proxy runs on a deterministic subsample, prune with successive halving, and propose the winner for a full run. Proposes; never promotes.

accept_license.description: Required true when base_model is a gated catalog entry (#2027, ADR-0102 D5).

dataset_uri.description: Prepared train set (jsonl with input/output), local path or s3:// URI.

epochs.description: Fallback for a portfolio entry that does not set one.

fidelity_fraction.description: Share of the corpus each proxy trains on. 1 % is the designed fidelity (§3.5.4).

fidelity_rows.description: Absolute row cap instead of a fraction (0 = use the fraction).

fidelity_seed.description: Subsample seed. The same seed reproduces the same rows and the same row-hash digest — which is what makes two trials comparable.

learning_rate.description: Fallback for a portfolio entry that does not set one.

max_steps.description: Proxy runs are SHORT by design; this is the other half of 'cheap'.

metric_name.description: What the reported number IS — named on the record and in the proposal.

min_resource.description: Steps in the pruner's first rung.

portfolio.description: Portfolio entries to enqueue. Empty = the study already holds what T9 enqueued.

portfolio_key.description: method·tuning_type·size_band — the study T9 enqueued the portfolio into (e.g. sft·qlora·<=2B).

promote_ref.description: The pipeline a promotion would re-launch at full fidelity.

reduction_factor.description: Successive halving: the share promoted per rung (2 = the surviving half).

stub.description: Run the whole round against the stub trainer — no GPU, no spend.

training/retrain-cycle.description: A bounded retrain cycle: take a window of fresh governed signal, mix prior-cycle rows back in, continue the previous cycle's adapter, measure the new adapter against the one it would replace on the same harness, gate on both the improvement AND the absence of forgetting, and promote only through a human decision. Cycle N+1 continues from cycle N's adapter.

accept_license.description: Required true when base_model is a gated catalog entry (#2027, ADR-0102 D5); ignored otherwise.

artifact_target.description: Where the adapter is persisted: hf | local | s3.

base_adapter.description: The adapter cycle 1 continues from. EMPTY (the default) = cycle 1 trains from the bare base; a non-empty URI adopts an existing chain.

challenger_endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving the newly trained adapter (vLLM --enable-lora / llama.cpp GGUF). Repointed at the `serve-challenger` gate each cycle.

challenger_model.description: Model id the challenger endpoint expects.

champion_endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving the CHAMPION (the adapter the cycle starts from). A stable NAME, repointed by the operator when a cycle is promoted — inputs are fixed for a run, so the endpoint identity, not the URL, is what carries the chain.

champion_model.description: Model id the champion endpoint expects.

dataset.description: The cycle's FRESH signal: a governed dataset append (path or resolved URI). Until the capture ingress (#1629) lands this is any appended slice — an import, a review export, a labelled batch.

delta_thresholds.description: eval/delta's regression budget (% of the baseline value) plus the direction overrides the built-in map cannot classify. Hallucination rates MUST be declared: an unclassifiable metric is skipped, never guessed, and a silently skipped hallucination rate is the one number you most want the gate to see move the wrong way.

epochs.description: Passes over the mix (ignored while max_steps > 0).

eval_set.description: The held-out QA corpus, split-labelled, that BOTH measurements ask. The `control` split is what the forgetting gate reads, so it must be the SAME rows every cycle or the comparison is meaningless.

eval_split.description: Fraction of the mix held out for mid-training eval.

forgetting_directions.description: Per-metric direction overrides for the forgetting comparison; same convention as eval/delta. Empty is fine while the metrics are accuracies.

forgetting_metrics.description: What the no-forgetting gate judges. Each must exist on BOTH measurements or the leg fails LOUD — an absent number must never read as 'no forgetting'.

forgetting_tolerance.description: Slack in the metric's OWN units (accuracy points, not %): control_acc(vN) >= control_acc(vN-1) - tolerance.

gpu.description: GPU type the backend provisions (T4, A10G, A100, …).

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id for artifact_target=hf; empty = derived from output_name.

judge_model.description: Gateway model that grades answers correct | hallucinated | abstain. Judge-scored gains are untrusted_metric — see the header.

learning_rate.description: Steerable per cycle by a human-approved suggestion (Amendment 1 item 3); must be > 0.

lora_alpha.description: LoRA alpha (scaling). MUST match the prior cycle.

lora_r.description: LoRA rank. MUST match the prior cycle when continuing its adapter.

max_error_rate.description: Highest per-split error_rate (endpoint errors + unparsed judge answers, as a fraction of the split) either measurement may carry and still count as valid. 0.0 = every row must be measured.

max_eval_loss.description: Checkpoint-acceptance ceiling inside the flow (0 = no ceiling) — fail fast before packaging.

max_per_split.description: Cost guard on the two eval legs (0 = every question).

method.description: PEFT method for the SFT rung (qlora|lora). NOT the SFT/DPO/GRPO selector — see the header.

min_new_rows.description: readiness bar: fewer surviving rows than this and the cycle STOPS before any paid compute.

packing.description: Pack short rows into fixed-length sequences (predictable VRAM); false for small short-row sets where one packed step would equal an epoch. MUST match the prior cycle (ruling 7) — cycle 1 trained with false.

pii_backend.description: Redaction backend for the hygiene leg.

registered_model_name.description: MLflow Registered Model for each cycle's adapter (empty = none).

replay_out_path.description: Where each cycle writes its mixed train slice. Every cycle in a run REWRITES this path — the durable record of a cycle's mix is the leg's `mix`/`ratio_actual` findings, not the file (the wire grammar cannot expand a per-iteration path).

replay_ratio.description: Replay share of the MIX (denominator = output rows). The knob a forgetting breach asks a human to raise (Amendment 1 item 3).

replay_seed.description: Same inputs + same seed → byte-identical mix, so a cycle is reproducible from its receipt.

replay_sources.description: Prior-cycle train slices, OLDEST first — governed `dataset:<name>@<v>` refs (resolved at submit, #1687), URIs, or local paths.

replay_strategy.description: uniform | recency_weighted. hard_example / forgetting_aware are RESERVED and fail loudly until they can consume per-row eval history.

report_to.description: Experiment-tracking sinks. An input, not an inline list, so it stays steerable per run.

save_steps.description: Checkpoint every N steps; a restart resumes from the last one.

save_total_limit.description: Keep only the N most-recent checkpoints (0 = unbounded).

seed.description: Training seed (distinct from replay_seed, which fixes the MIX).

stub.description: Hermetic trainer (no torch) — the conformance tier.

target_modules.description: Comma-separated LoRA targets. Empty = the trainer's default. MUST match the prior cycle.

validate_pipeline.description: Run the whole training path on CPU with a tiny model first — zero GPU spend.

plan_steps.gate: steps.champion.findings.eval_closedbook_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.champion.findings.eval_closedbook_paraphrase_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.champion.findings.eval_closedbook_control_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.challenger.findings.eval_closedbook_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.challenger.findings.eval_closedbook_paraphrase_eval_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate && steps.challenger.findings.eval_closedbook_control_error_rate <= input.max_error_rate

gpu_memory_utilization.description: vLLM GPU memory fraction for the served endpoint (default 0.9).

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id (user/name) when artifact_target=hf.

max_model_len.description: Max context length for the served endpoint (default None → model default).

max_steps.description: Cap training steps; >0 overrides epochs (default 0 = use epochs).

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI (e.g. http://mlflow.host:5000). Passed to the box as MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI so the trainer's MLflowCallback logs there. Empty → the box's own MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI env (if any); absent both ⇒ no MLflow logging.

mock_adapter_uri.description: e2e only — when set, train/stub returns this REAL adapter URI instead of training (mock-train → real artifact).

mock_metrics.description: e2e only — real metrics returned alongside mock_adapter_uri (e.g. {train_loss, eval_loss}).

model_gate_thresholds.description: Overrides for the model-eval gate (model/gate). Keys mirror ModelGateThresholds, notably min_benchmark_scores — a {suite/metric: min} map, e.g. {"ifeval/prompt_level_strict_acc": 0.4}. Absent keys keep the operator defaults.

notion_page_id.description: Notion page id to append the run summary to (run-publish-notion). Empty → publish skipped gracefully.

output_name.description: Name for the produced adapter + registry model (default "adapter").

prep_enabled.description: Run the PII-scrub + train/val/test split front-stage and train on the scrubbed train split (default false).

price_per_hr.description: Actual GPU rental price $/hr for the cost estimate/gate. Unset → the built-in per-GPU heuristic.

report_to.description: Experiment trackers to report to, e.g. ["mlflow"] (default [] = none).

run_benchmark.description: Run the public-benchmark step (eval/benchmark) on the trained adapter (default false).

save_steps.description: Write a training checkpoint every N steps (feeds save_steps + the S3 mirror). Smaller ⇒ more frequent durable checkpoints; default lets the trainer pick (~every steps/2).

serve_enabled.description: After a successful promote, serve the model behind a vLLM endpoint and benchmark it (default false). Requires a GPU compute_target.

serve_port.description: Port for the served vLLM endpoint (default 8000).

served_model_name.description: OpenAI-API model name for the served endpoint (default "cairn-model").

slack_channel.description: Slack channel override for the run summary (run-notify-slack). Empty → the webhook's default channel.

stage.description: Registry stage to promote into (default staging).

test_ratio.description: Prep split held-out test fraction (default 0.1) — the split the significance gate scores on.

topic.description: Free-text topic for the RAG/memory steps in the e2e-fullstack template (recall-context / remember-run).

tracking_project.description: Tracking experiment/project name (MLflow experiment / W&B project). Default the output_name.

tracking_run_name.description: Tracking run name (default the cairn run_id).

train_command.description: Override the on-box training command for train/remote (default "cairn-train-local").

validate_pipeline.description: Validate the WHOLE pipeline on CPU before GPU (#536): a tiny random model + throttle runs the real dataset/gates/tracking/eval path in ~10-20 min with zero GPU. Also settable per-box via CAIRN_TRAIN_VALIDATE=1 (default false).

validate_seconds.description: Stretch the validate-mode tiny job to a real wall-time (CAIRN_TRAIN_VALIDATE_SECONDS) so cancel/resume/poll have time to act (default 0).

training/train-managed.description: Fine-tune on a MANAGED GPU provider (RunPod, Vast.ai or Modal) as a governed task leg: a cost estimate, a data gate that fails closed on the budget, a human authorization gate in front of the only leg that bills, the provider job running the pinned cairn-train-gpu image and streaming its curve over the job channel, a human promote gate, and a teardown finalizer that cancels the provider job on failure or cancel.

accept_license.description: Required true when base_model is a gated catalog entry (#2027, ADR-0102 D5); ignored otherwise.

artifact_target.description: Where the adapter is persisted: s3 | hf | local.

compute_connection.description: Name of the `compute.<provider>` connection that pays for this run (from `cairn connect runpod` / `cairn connect vast`). A pipeline `task:` leg carries no compute binding, so this is how the operator is told which account and which GPU type to use — see `TrainSpec.compute_connection`. Empty is only correct for `provider: stub`.

dataset_uri.description: Prepared train set (jsonl with input/output): local path, s3:// URI or HF id.

epochs.description: Passes over the set (ignored while max_steps > 0).

est_gpu.description: GPU the estimate prices against (drives $/hr + the VRAM fit).

gpu.description: GPU type the provider provisions; the connection's gpu_type/gpu_name overrides it.

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id for artifact_target=hf; empty = derived from output_name.

init_adapter_uri.description: Adapter to CONTINUE training from; empty = fresh.

max_cost_usd.description: Hard ceiling for the estimate. The `cost-in-budget` gate is a DATA gate, so an estimate above this STOPS the pipeline — it is not a warning a human can wave through, which is the point of putting it before the approval.

output_name.description: Adapter name. ALSO the teardown's selector — see the teardown step.

provider.description: Which managed provider runs the train leg: `runpod` (default — the most proven of the three), `vast`, `modal`, or `stub` for the zero-spend rehearsal. It selects which of the four `train-*` legs is routed ON; the rest are skipped.

registered_model_name.description: MLflow Registered Model for the adapter (empty = none).

report_to.description: Experiment trackers; credentials come from tracking.* connections (#136).

target_modules.description: LoRA target modules, e.g. [q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj]; empty = the trainer's default.

validate_pipeline.description: Run the whole training path on CPU with a tiny model first — zero GPU spend.

training/train-only.description: Fine-tune (QLoRA) on a prepared dataset as a single remote ML job; package the candidate adapter. No data prep, no eval — those are separate runs.

accept_license.description: Required true when base_model is a gated catalog entry (#2027, ADR-0102 D5); ignored otherwise.

artifact_target.description: Where the adapter is persisted: s3 (CAIRN_CHECKPOINT_BUCKET/PREFIX/<run>/adapter), local, or hf.

dataset_uri.description: Prepared train set (jsonl with input/output), local path or s3:// URI.

epochs.description: Passes over the training set (ignored while max_steps > 0).

eval_split.description: Fraction held out for mid-training eval.

fidelity_fraction.description: Train on this share of the corpus, e.g. 0.01 for a 1 % proxy run (0 = all).

fidelity_rows.description: Train on at most N rows (0 = the whole corpus). Wins over fidelity_fraction.

fidelity_seed.description: Subsample seed. The SAME seed reproduces the same rows and the same row-hash digest.

gpu.description: GPU type the backend provisions (T4, A10G, A100, …).

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id for artifact_target=hf; empty = derived from output_name.

init_adapter_uri.description: Adapter to CONTINUE training from (s3://…/adapter/), for two-stage recipes (#1463). Empty = fresh adapter.

learning_rate.description: Optimizer lr; drop to ~5e-5 for calibration passes continuing an adapter.

packing.description: Pack short rows into fixed-length sequences (predictable VRAM); false for small short-row sets where one packed step would equal an epoch.

registered_model_name.description: MLflow Registered Model to add this adapter to as a new version (empty = none).

report_to.description: Experiment trackers: mlflow and/or wandb (empty = none).

save_steps.description: Checkpoint every N steps; a restart resumes from the last one.

save_total_limit.description: Keep only the N most-recent checkpoints (0 = unbounded).

target_modules.description: Comma-separated LoRA targets, e.g. q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj (attention-only). Empty = trainer default (all attention + MLP).

validate_pipeline.description: Run the whole training path on CPU with a tiny model first — zero GPU spend.

training/verifiable-finetune.description: Synthesize post-cutoff facts into closed-book QA, measure the base model (novelty + hallucination), fine-tune on the train facts, serve the adapter, re-measure on held-out facts / paraphrases / control, and gate promotion on the measured delta.

accept_license.description: Required true when base_model is a gated catalog entry (#2027, ADR-0102 D5); ignored otherwise.

artifact_target.description: Where the adapter is persisted: hf | local | s3.

baseline_endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving the BASE model for the novelty measurement (e.g. llama.cpp http://host:8081).

baseline_model.description: Model id the baseline endpoint expects.

cutoff.description: Base model knowledge cutoff (facts are sampled AFTER this date).

days.description: Event days sampled across the window (≈3 cited facts/day).

end.description: Last date to sample facts from (empty = today).

epochs.description: Passes over the training set (ignored while max_steps > 0).

eval_fraction.description: Share of FACTS held out for eval (never seen in any phrasing).

eval_split.description: Fraction held out for mid-training eval (distinct from eval_fraction, which splits the FACTS).

forgetting_metrics.description: Findings the no-forgetting gate judges. Each must exist on BOTH the baseline and post legs or the leg fails loud — an absent number must never read as 'no forgetting'.

forgetting_tolerance.description: Control-split accuracy the model may lose before no-forgetting blocks, in accuracy points.

gpu.description: GPU type the backend provisions (T4, A10G, A100, …).

hf_repo.description: HF Hub repo id for artifact_target=hf; empty = derived from output_name.

init_adapter_uri.description: Adapter to CONTINUE training from. Empty = a fresh adapter.

judge_model.description: Gateway model for QA generation and answer grading.

max_baseline_acc.description: novelty gate: stop if the base model already answers more than this share of held-out facts.

max_facts.description: Cost guard on QA generation (0 = all collected facts).

max_per_split.description: Cost guard for the eval legs (0 = every question).

max_steps.description: Training steps (≈2 epochs over ~350 rows at bs 2×grad-acc).

measure_forgetting.description: Run the eval/forgetting leg + no-forgetting gate over the control split (#1626). OFF by default — the promote gate already SHOWS the control pair to a human; turning this on makes it a blocking gate.

output_name.description: Name of the produced LoRA adapter.

packing.description: Pack short rows into fixed-length sequences (predictable VRAM).

post_endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving base+adapter (vLLM --enable-lora / llama.cpp GGUF).

post_eval.description: Run the post-train measurement (needs post_endpoint serving the trained adapter).

post_model.description: Model id the post endpoint expects (the served adapter name).

registered_model_name.description: MLflow Registered Model to add this adapter to (empty = none).

report_to.description: Experiment trackers: mlflow and/or wandb (empty = none).

save_steps.description: Checkpoint every N steps; a restart resumes from the last one.

save_total_limit.description: Keep only the N most-recent checkpoints (0 = unbounded).

target_modules.description: Comma-separated LoRA targets. Empty = the trainer's default.

validate_pipeline.description: Run the whole training path on CPU with a tiny model first — zero GPU spend.
